reviews.title: Cramp-A-Lot Airlines
reviews.text: Should have been flying on a Dreamliner with TUI but we were notified two or three weeks prior that we would be flying by Cramp-A-Lot Airlines, A.K.A. Euro Atlantic, this was not good news for a nervous flyer and NOT what we paid for. I couldn't bring myself to read reviews prior, I thought it's best I not know. This was one of the worst flights I had ever been on, it was so unbelievably uncomfortable, no where to put anything (minimal cleaning) I'm sure it would have been more comfortable in an outside seat on the wing! The aircraft looked as if it was held together with duck tape, toilets dreadful, we were delayed (not their fault) but we had a further two hours sitting in our cramped seats. Once we had got going, I had hoped they may be round with water or a drink quite quickly but no of course not. We waited ages for the trolley to come along with offerings of food and drink, this was then another challenge of trying to eat and drink in a tiny space and no where to put anything, table was broken, we weren't kept informed by staff of any flight information what so ever. Then came the landing, lot's of banking on the decent then I couldn't believe it! the plane just slammed down on the tarmac, everyone was very shocked, yelped etc I practically jumped out of my seat, it was awful, I looked at the cabin crew whose facial expression hadn't budged, quite unreal. All I can say is thank goodness I didn't have to endure it again on the way home...
reviews.author: Lemonpopsical

reviews.title: Do not fly on this Crap
reviews.text: Got in from terceira to Oakland, row 31 center family at 4, tv did not work so we add to seat in the back 4 different seats so we could watch a movie , ask for headphones they said they did not add any so only visual no sound, no pillows no blankets , seats dirty, 1 meal one hour after the flight start , next meal was 1h30 before landing was one small Sandwich. On a 10 hour flight we add a 7 hour break no drinks no snack, I went ask for a snack to buy or if they add any because kids , they said they don’t have nothing , the only option was giving them the small sandwich now and later there was nothing. I been flying international 2 times a year I never saw anything like this, poor service , the flight attendant suck also. Was my first time and last with this company, I will NEVER fly again here , if you want to have your own experience enjoy the ride …..
reviews.author: Usa2020

reviews.title: Dire
reviews.text: We booked a Marella/TUI cruise and got an email a few days before departure telling us we are now flying with Euroatlantic. The aircraft was so old it looked like it belonged in an aircraft museum, cramped tiny seats rude disinterested flight attendants, in what can only be described as an attempt to save some face TUI had two of their own crew on the way back TUI could not have found a cheaper option if they had tried I am in the process of cancelling the holiday I booked in December as I simply don’t trust them not no swap flights at the last minute This is NOT what I booked and it its NOT what I paid for
reviews.author: Cletus_10

reviews.title: AWFUL
reviews.text: We should have been flying with Tui but they changed our aircraft to euro Atlantic. Seats were incredibly uncomfortable and inflight entertainment not working properly. We're disgusted as all we got was a tiny pot of water and a twix for a 4 and half hour flight. My partner is recovering from throat cancer and needs hot drinks on a regular basis. We were appalled as there was no in-flight service to buy any food or drink, either hot or cold.
reviews.author: Tracy Y

reviews.title: Awful airline
reviews.text: Dreadful customer service. Had a bottle of water and a packet of crisps thrown at us. No engagement from the crew at all, they were rude and dismissive. Did the service as quickly as possible and then hid in the galley until the fasten seatbelt signs came on. Quick check of seatbelts but no securing of hand baggage. I will never fly with them again. A smile goes a long way.
reviews.author: SezzieB

reviews.title: Worst International flight I have been to.
reviews.text: Flying from Male to Toronto. Flight was 3 hours late from Male Very bad in-flight services. We have been served food only once since last 8 hours. No snack, tea or coffee. Lights were turned off throughout. No infotainment on the plan. Not even charging ports.
reviews.author: Tanmay T

reviews.title: Repatriation flight
reviews.text: As this was a repatriation flight from a cancelled cruise. I personally thought the crew very friendly and helpful. wifi for in flight entertainment was good but alas no ear phones my fault not the airlines in flight meals we were told by ground staff caterers had let them down but we were all fed no alcohol on board which personally I don't think is a bad thing. Coffee tea or soft drinks only had to ask . Well what can I say about my seat well I can honestly say it's the first time ever I've been comfortable enough to sleep on an aircraft perfect .I can't thank the aircrew enough
reviews.author: Kevin L

reviews.title: Should have the entertainment system in order
reviews.text: The flight is quite long for not having the entertainment system in order. The crew is very friendly and the food portions are quite generous. Enjoy!
reviews.author: Vitor A

reviews.title: Quite old airplane
reviews.text: The airplane was quite old (still having ashtrays in the toilets!). As it was a night flight, one didn’t miss too much the lack of entertainment system (it was broken). Enjoy!
reviews.author: Vitor A

reviews.title: Marella Discovery repatriation
reviews.text: After a FANTASTIC cruise on Marella Discovery which unfortunately was cut short due to Corona virus scare we had to be flown home on this replacement airline. Service on board patchy at best with 9 hours between meals on a 13 hour flight. No entertainment at all as crew couldn't get the screens working which also meant no reading light and as we were flying east to west leaving after dark we were constantly flying at night so nothing to do but sit and try and sleep. No booze on plane and no drinks service at all between meals. Possible to get drink only by going to crew station and asking for one. Still it didn't crash and we arrived home safely which was most important thing. Also thanks to Marella/Tui for arranging after cruise cancelled. Must have been a logistical nightmare. Steve Kelsey
reviews.author: Stephen k

reviews.title: Friendly crew
reviews.text: A very pleasant flight , friendly crew , good food . The only thing is that the seats have very little legroom and the entertainment is poor .
reviews.author: fedtnt

reviews.title: The most awful flight I've had
reviews.text: The most awful flight I've had. I booked a flight with LOT to Krakow. After boarding I realized that the flight is not operated by LOT - Polish Airlines, as stated on my ticket, but it was operated by Euro Atlantic. The worst aircraft ever!! Seats were extremely narro, uncomfortable and in very poor condition. Multimedia didn’t work. Flight attendants spoke very bad English. Announcements were only in English! I was expecting Polish LOT crew speaking Polish and Polish multimedia!!! LOT customer service lied to me when I asked about the aircraft info prior to my flight!!!! I filed a complaint, it is still pending. Never recommend this to anyone!
reviews.author: Anna Joanna

reviews.title: The absolute worst airline in existence!
reviews.text: Norwegian Air substituted this carrier the night before we were leaving, notifying us by text at 2:00 AM, also removing our upgraded seating, that was purchased to help me get through severe Restless Legs Syndrome bouts. These aircraft are the worst! Tight seating, no leg space, no entertainment, no food, one drink. If you every get booked on one of these cancel your trip.
reviews.author: rengel134

reviews.title: our flight home
reviews.text: we flew home on this aircraft after thomas cook collapsed and the plane was sent to pick us up from Rhodes airport the plane was delayed for two hours from where ever it came from, as we boarded the plane we was told to sit where we wanted as the there was lots of room, the plane was big and more comfy than the one we arrived on the staff were very very friendly and helpful, they served us food and soft drinks whjich we wasn't charged for I want to thank the staff and the aircraft that brought home A BIG THANK YOU
reviews.author: freddyfrog54

reviews.title: Much better than the other reviews
reviews.text: There are so many very negative reviews of euroAtlantic that I was prepared for the worst when I found out that LOT Polish Airlines had wet leased with EuroAtlantic to replace their grounded 787s. The leased flight was operated with an EuroAtlantic crew but the food catering was from LOT. The 767-300 was old, but the cabin had been retrofitted with a new interior and in-flight entertainment system. The seating in business was 1-2-1 in semi-private pods, a significant step up from the 2-2-2 seating that LOT uses in its 787s in business. The economy section is 2-4-2, and it did look pretty cramped. There was a large crew of flight attendents who were very friendly and attentive. The food was better than average for business class. The in-flight entertainment system was excellent. The only downsides I saw was language barrier problems with some of the flight attendents, and the flight operating almost three hours behind schedule. Of course, the biggest advantage was that even though the plane was old, I didn't have to worry about its engines self-destructing half way across the Atlantic, as I would have in the 787 with its disintegrating fan blades in its Rolls Royce engines. Most of the negative reviews seem to come from those poor travellers caught up in the Thomas Cook collapse. I really feel for them and the high stress repatriation they experienced. But, my EuroAtlantic flight was at least on par with the business class international products of Delta and American.
reviews.author: Gary A

reviews.title: Basic flight
reviews.text: Recovery flight for stranded Thomas Cook customers Although this was a recovery flight the inflight entertainment did not work. The food was basic , however cold fish on bun was a dodgy I felt. Food was not marked well ...one person suffered an allergic reaction An Eppee pen was requested for a passenger who suffered a nut reaction. ( I am surprised that type of item is not carried on all flights) Crew were professional but all appeared to have different uniforms, but that might of been because they had been dragged off other flights. Due to this one flight (although in unusual circumstances) I would not choose to fly with them again Leg room was extremely limited, again may have been down to circumstances
reviews.author: Steven B

reviews.title: Repat flight
reviews.text: Cant moan to much as was a replacement flight from Thomas cook no longer trading. Flight crew rarely talked captain not alot and coudnt understand through the tannoy. Given a small roll and a plastic cup of drink after take of. Coudnt buy any food or drink on board which was no good after being delayed 3.5 hours.
reviews.author: Lewis

reviews.title: Thomas Cook repatriation flight Cayo coco to Gatwick
reviews.text: We have just flown from Cayo coco cuba to Gatwick today on a Thomas Cook repatriation flight. It was with euro Atlantic, we were fortunate enough to sit in row 16 which is in the business class, premium section. Be aware that their is no section 13 or 14. It jumps from 12 to 15 so if you get a seat in 13 or 14 it doesn't exist. We found the seats very comfortable with electric tilt and fold out part for your feet. The plane was an ex tui 767 plane so was quite noisy. So be aware of this. Food was OK and the staff were quick and friendly. Their is no in flight entertainment so be aware of this.
reviews.author: Gavin

reviews.title: Thomas Cook rescue flight
reviews.text: Travelled home with Euro Atlantic on a Thomas Cook rescue flight and was fortunate to be allocated a seat in business class. I have never travelled business class before and while certainly the most basic of business class offerings I have looked at the seat was spacious and very comfortable and the cabin was spotlessly clean. The Crew were wonderful, polite and easy going and really took care of everyone. Thank you for a pleasant return journey home and for the hospitality recieved under the unfortunate circumstance. Would happily fly Euro Atlantic again.
reviews.author: AndyRob

reviews.title: Thomas cook replacement
reviews.text: This was a replacement flight home and after some reading online I was not filled with confidence about the trip home. However the whole experience itself was not bad. The crew were friendly . The pilot was very informative. The seats where not the best, leg room was okay but the seats themselves were very narrow! Glad I was only on for a few hours and not long haul! Food was provided and toilets where clean :) all in all not the best flight but we got home!
reviews.author: Rosie Y

reviews.title: Much better than anticipated!
reviews.text: This was a replacement flight for Thomas Cook one we should been on and having read the reviews I was dreading it. However I was very pleasantly surprised. The seats weren’t the most comfy but we’re fine, no problem with leg room , the staff were lovely, very pleasant and helpful. Bonus was having a free sandwich, soft drink and water. I hope my review helps to reassure others!
reviews.author: kerry f

reviews.title: Repatriation flight for Thomas Cook
reviews.text: Very grateful to be on a flight home after the collapse of Thomas Cook. This is the first flight I have ever been on that took off virtually on time. The staff were very friendly and pleasant. We were provided with drinks and a meal, which was a lovely gesture and welcomely received. The seats were comfortable with plenty of legroom. Lots of information given by the pilot and staff. Definitely deserves 5 stars! Thank you.
reviews.author: bizyboz

reviews.title: Bait and switch
reviews.text: We were originally booked through Norwegian but during our vacation, I got an email saying our new 787 was being replaced by euroatlantic airlines. The did offer to fully refund our flight and book another airline buy when you are on a cruise, it is very difficult to so that. I tried to research this airline but I could not find a good review. I figured most people that do reviews are malcontents. Boy were we wrong. Euroatlantic was the worst airline I ever flew on. Smelly,old,dirty plane. We probably would have been more comfortable sitting on a spackle bucket for 9 hours. The food was not edible. I yearned for the days for a school lunch over this. The crew was nice but spent most of their time congregating on the front eating much better food than the passengers. There was no IFE so the only thing was to try to sleep, but that was impossible because of crew constantly dropping things to startle you awake. If you get booked on this airline, take my advice. Take the refund, pay the extra $1500 on another airline
reviews.author: JP_Murse

reviews.title: The most horrible intercontinental flight ever, wish I could give negative stars
reviews.text: Our flight was booked through Norwegian, who I have flown before and had great experiences, so I was shocked how abysmal this was. About a week before our flight, we received an email that our flight was now going through Euro Atlantic. Thank god I did not read the reviews beforehand, because I would have been in an extreme state of anxiety (and what are you supposed to do!? you can't cancel and rebook your flight for vacation!). There were zero pros about this flight, so here are the cons: -We were supposed to fly out at 11:30 PM. We booked an evening flight because it was about $1000 cheaper and we didn't want to waste vacation time on an airplane. The morning of our flight, we receive a notification we are not going to be departing at 12:15 AM instead. At first, I didn't think this was a big deal, and when we got to the airport we were told it was still on for 11:30 PM and the boards still showed that. Then 11:30 passes, 12:15 passes, and we still have not boarded. Now we are being told we are not taking off until 1:30 AM. 1:30 AM arrives and we still have not boarded. We didn't get on the plan until almost 2 AM, then after everyone was on WE SAT THERE FOR AN HOUR and didn't take off until 3 AM. We were supposed to land around 1:30 PM Rome time, so I thought we'd have a few hours of the afternoon, but we did not land until almost 5 PM. -THERE WERE NO TVs - this is an international flight and 2019, and the airlines gouge you for money. This is not acceptable. -I am a very small woman - 5'4", 130lbs - and the seats were too small for me. Not kidding, the seat was as wide as my hips, no cushion (I had a metal bar going up my back), and zero legroom (where my legs would have gone, there was a metal bar from the seat in front of me, and I had to share under seat storage with the person next to me because of the way the chairs were - I don't know why). Needless to say, I did not sleep, so I stared at the seat in front of me for 8 hours. -The staff was extremely unprofessional. They were in the backroom goofing off and flirting with each other. -Once we landed and finally deplaned, the way FCO is set up, you take a shuttle to the baggage claim. From landing to getting off the shuttle was probably 45 minutes. We got to the baggage claim, and the carousel was not moving. We waited another 30-40 minutes until it started up. So by the time we got a cab and got to our hotel, it was already after 6 PM and we lost our first half-day of our trip.
reviews.author: Lauren

reviews.title: It's fine.
reviews.text: I came on the plane fearing for the worst but when I reached my seat and sat down, it was fine. The leg room was okay and I'm a long legged 6'0 man, some discomfort but whatever. The TV thing didn't work or I couldn't get it to work. There was onboard WiFi but it only worked for whatever they had on their website and the plane didn't have any power outlets so bring power banks. But honestly in general the plane was okay, nothing that'd make it unairworthy or be considered the *WORST AIRLINE EVER*, I felt fine flying on it when they chartered Norwegian's flight and was worried that it would be horrible but it wasn't.
reviews.author: Roman Rosales

reviews.title: MICKEY MOUSE AIRLINE
reviews.text: Flew Euro Atlantic, round trip, with my wife, because Norwegian Airlines screwed us, buy charging us for tickets for a flight they knew would not fly, either way. On the way to Rome, I had to sit in a broken seat, that could not recline, for over 8 hours. We took off late, landed late, and we almost missed the Mediterranean cruise that we flew to take. NIGHTMARE! They have NO MOVIES, or ANY IN FLIGHT ENTERTAINMENT ! 8 hours of ZERO !
reviews.author: Zurrie

reviews.title: Worst plane I’ve been on
reviews.text: I’ve flown budget airlines all over the world, and flown more than 68,000 miles this year. This was my worst flight ever. I had booked on Norwegian but the day before they switched us to EuroAtlantic. I was prepared for it to be a lesser experience than the Dreamliner, which I’ve flown with them a lot and love, but this was next level awful. We left an hour late, the plane was old and filthy (looked like it hadn’t had a basic cleaning in months), and of course no amentities - no WiFi, no IFE, not even a seat back pocket to put my phone in. The seats were so tiny that my 5’6” self barely fit (also super uncomfortable), and the aisles were tiny as well. Our armrests were broken, the seat in front of me was stuck in a recliner position, and there wasn’t room for anyone’s luggage. The food was literally inedible - barely cooked rice in a “risotto” for my veggie meal. So crunchy. I’ve been a loyal Norwegian customer for years, but after this I’m never booking with them again. This plane made RyanAir look like the Concorde.
reviews.author: Kathleen O'Donnell

reviews.title: An Abomination of Travel
reviews.text: All I can say is, do not fly this airline. After booking our flight with Norwegian, we were told the day before our departure that in order to avoid "major disruption" to our travel they had charted us on a EuroAtlantic flight. These planes should not only be discontinued, they should be an example of what not to do for all airlines. After reading reviews, I had prepped myself for the worst....but it was, if possible, worse then that. See list below: 1) There was NO entertainment for the whole 9.5 hour flight. No TV, no movies, nothing. There are a couple of the large TVs, but we were told they didn't work. 2) No wifi. Even though Norwegian touts there wonderful wifi- if you get rebooked on Euro Atlantic, don't expect any. 3) USB charing port did not work 4) Seats are outrageously small. Think Spirit airlines, but worse. I had to sit sideways. Before we even left a woman who was pregnant was asked to get off the plane because she did not fit. 5)There was no individual A/C and the plane was kept very warm. The plane had a very odd chemical smell while boarding and for the first part of the 2.5 hour delayed flight, but by the end it had an even worse BO stench. 6) With no explanation we left over 2.5 hour late and sat on the plane the entire time. No explanation. 7) Upon arriving in Newark it took TWO hours for the bags to come to baggage claim. The one and only airport employee still working at 2:30a said they were having issues opening the baggage compartment. If that doesn't tell you the plan needs to be discontinued then I don't know what does. The list goes on, but I'm getting angry just writing this. I submitted a formal complaint to Norwegian and still have had no response, so this review is just as much for them as it is for EuroAtlantic. Don't do either if you can avoid!
reviews.author: Matthew W

reviews.title: WORSE AIRLINE EVER!  DO NOT EVER FLY ON THIS AIRLINE EVEN IF FREE!!!!
reviews.text: My review exactly the same as everyone else's. This was absolutely the worst flight in my entire life. I caution you never ever ever fly on Euro Atlantic airlines. It is the worst airline ever. We are not kidding you when the seats are absolutely the most uncomfortable and smallest seats in the world even if you are tiny it is hard to get in-and-out of the seats. There's no leg Room there's no aisle room. There's no seating patting on the seats. The stewardesses were the most rudest, unfriendly and unprofessional people I've ever dealt with. The food was terrible the bathrooms were filthy and had no toilet paper or paper towels. The stewardess never came to pick up your trash and most of the passengers ended up cleaning up everything by walking up to trash bags and depositing their trash themselves. The best part of my 9 and a 1/2 hour flight was my 2 hour standing in an open area by nasty bathroom just so I could be a little more comfortable. Caution caution caution do not ever fly own Euro Atlantic airlines. I got stuck on this flight as a substitute for a Norwegian airline shuttle and it was the biggest disappointment ever! I would give them a -10 rating if I could. They should be appalled to put people on an airplane and call it service. They spilt hot coffee on a guy and never even apologized nor offered him another cup of coffee. It was absolutely the most horrible flight I've ever had in my life and I have flown on numerous different airlines to many different countries over the last 50 years. Stay away it is terrible! Norwegian airlines will be losing tons of business if they keep substituting by using this company. By far the worst experience of flying I have ever had in my entire life. And even if you are dead tired and had no sleep for 24 hours don't expect to get a wink of sleep on the most uncomfortable seats in the world. My flight was 10 hours long with no Wi-Fi no entertainment no TV no music no overhead lighting no air overhead... it was terrible. We're not kidding you when we say there is no room to move in the seats since the seat in front of you is right in your face it is just horrible. When the airplane is just completely painted white with absolutely no identification symbol of even the company name that should be a clue to stay away from that plane. Avoid at all cost!
reviews.author: wsn380

reviews.title: Should not be allowed to fly
reviews.text: This was one of two trips I have taken by this company, wet leased by Norwegian the first time and the second time wet leased ( meaning plane and crew) by LOT The experience from both flights was basically identical: Old, terribly maintained air crafts, nothing worked, from in flight entertainment to bath rooms. A crew that appeared totally untrained and only spoke Portuguese. A pilot, also very fluent in Portuguese. I felt very uneasy, worrying of 1) What would happen if there was a problem, with this "crew" ready to "assist" and 2) considering the state of plane, whether we would make it to our destination at all. I have never seen such inapt flight attendances in my entire life, never been on a plane that was virtually falling apart in front of my very eyes. I read recently that they had to return to Canada on a flight from JFK to Belfast because of a technical failure. Staff, not unsurprisingly, were unable to inform passengers what was going on, the pilot, I kid you not!! Told the passengers; ,Lets hope we can land this thing or the coast guard will have to pick us up"!! If you show up at some airport and realize that the plane waiting for you is "Euro Atlantic" turn around and run. If you get on that plane it may well be the last bad choice you ever made..
reviews.author: John J

reviews.title: Awful flight!
reviews.text: Just was flying from Rome to Newark. Norwegian replaced their craft to old one from Euro Atlantic. It was the most terrible flight I ever fly. Seats are for kinds adage 10 to 11, no legs space at all. Aircraft is very old, no TVs, wi-fi or any other entertainment. Food was disgusting, served by very young folks who did not care. Temperature was freezing even asked 3-4 times to make it warmer. Shame to Norwegian and Euro Atlantic to put people on 9.5 hour flight flying like animals.
reviews.author: VTA

reviews.title: The worst, horrible, scary experience
reviews.text: HORRIBLE. Boarding passes and flight information said Norwegian airline. Was not informed that Euro Atlantic Airways was the operating airline and so had no idea what I was getting myself into. Purchased a ticket with cabin baggage and personal item. Staff at Newark was extremely rude and made us check our carry-on bag. When we got onto the plane, there was plenty of overhead space available and many carry-on bags that were bigger/heavier than ours. Flight was an hour delayed and nobody from the airline or the airport informed us as to why. Plane was extremely old, no overhead air vent or in flight entertainment, small seats and little leg room. Overhead lights were broken. 3 hours into the flight, Captain comes over loud speaker and says “we are preparing our decent to Gander” even though our final destination was Rome... causes a huge stir, flight attendants started sprinting up and down the aisles as if there’s an emergency. There was no information from any of the staff as to what was going on. Passengers started to freak out and ask questions and we were told “I don’t know” by the staff. It turns out, we needed to make an emergency landing in Gander due to technical difficulties. That was all the information we received. Spent 7 hours sitting and waiting in the Gander airport before being shuttles to hotels. Currently sitting in my hotel room as in writing this review. There’s been no information as to next steps on travel. Captain did a nice job landing us and everyone is safe - however - extremely poor communication to the passengers and created a lot of chaos, was speaking another language to his staff over the loud speaker. Still don’t really know what happened on the plane or what is happening next, when. This is a nightmare.
reviews.author: Amanda W

reviews.title: Grueling Trip
reviews.text: This was originally a Norwegian flight but for some reason they handed it off to a EuroAtlantic plane and crew. Yes, the crew was not from Norwegian. There were so many elements of the trip that made it much more uncomfortable than an economy flight usually is. First, the extremely narrow seats. I measured mine at 2.3 Kindles, or approximately 15-16 inches, with the arm rests making it even narrower. Perhaps the seat size works on short haul flights but this one was nine plus hours. Second, there was no entertainment of any kind, wifi or otherwise or even usb plugs, another indication that this EuroAtlantic plane usually flies shorter flight legs. Third, the food was beyond dreadful, both for the dinner and breakfast. My chicken was dry to the point of tastelessness and the potatoes so overmicrowaved as to be inedible. Next, the crew was inept and inefficient, slow to deliver meals and very slow to pick up trays, we waited almost an hour for them to pick up trays, though the had ample time to chat together in the galley. It was like this was their first long distance flight ever. They kept ferrying food canisters back and forth from one galley to another and then repacking it in the rolling carts while kneeling on the cabin floor. I’ve never seen anything like it. Plus they closed the galley curtains and discouraged passengers from moving through to use the bathrooms. One bathroom didn’t work which was unconscionable on such a long flight. No pillows or blankets were offered or even available despite the arctic temps in the cabin . They did not go through the cabin to collect trash in the usual way, and they often acted as if the passengers were an inconvenience. Using this plane and crew on a Norwegian flight was a poor customer-service choice. It is my hope I will never have to go through such a grueling journey again.
reviews.author: Barbara Castleton

reviews.title: NEVER AGAIN
reviews.text: NEVER EVER FLYING NORWEGIAN AGAIN. We were unfortunately put on a Euro Atlantic flight by Norwegian and it was hands down the worst travel experience we've ever had. The seats were SO SMALL, not even a commuter plane has seats that uncomfortable. No space between rows, no entertainment, the flight attendants were super rude. I was travelling with my husband and our one-year-old and they changed our seats so I was sitting alone and my husband was with my daughter. We luckily were able to swap our seats with a nice gentleman who was travelling alone. I'm appalled, it was truly hell and our backs still hurt after a week! I've never ever written a TripAdvisor review, but I had to warn anyone who's considering using this line or has had Norwegian swap aircrafts. STAY AWAY!!! (the only good thing about this flight was the pilot, he was kind, informative, and great during turbulence, taking off, and landing).
reviews.author: Valentina N

reviews.title: Avoid this Airline (and Norwegian).
reviews.text: I'm one of the unlucky travelers that were put on this airline by Norwegian for a 8h intercontinental flight. The experience was terrible for the following reasons: -The plane was old and it smelled terribly (I'm not entirely sure it wasn't one of those planes were people used to smoke). -The AC didn't work right, sometimes it was really hot and then after a while it was again normal temperature, like it was turning on and off repeatedly. -Seats were extremely CRAMPED. I was sitting near a tall guy with broad shoulders and he just didn't fit the seat. He ended up on mine, with his shoulders invading a good portion of my seat for 8 hours. -Legroom is terrible and god forbid if the person sitting in front of you decides to recline its seat since it reclines a lot and basically kills all your space. A lot of people were arguing with people in front of them. -The seat is uncomfortable and hard, but also narrow so larger people could have serious trouble just sitting on it. -No in flight entertainment whatsoever. -Persistent light and really noisy, good luck sleeping without eye-mask and headphones. -Some staff tried their best, but some where just outright rude. One decided it would be nice to just ram into my knee with his cart instead of, i don't know, waking me up and asking if i could move the leg. -Good luck if you paid for any perk like business/premium class, there isn't anything like that. -They assign you random seats, even if you had purchased extra legroom or other perks. On top of all this, the plane also had one hour delay. I've never traveled so uncomfortably and I've traveled with a lot of questionable means during my lifetime. Lastly, beware of positive reviews like "oh, for me the experience was nice because i had extra legroom seats." and the likes. There are only few rows of extra legroom seats available and they DO NOT give you one if you had reserved it on Norwegian. It's just random. This means that you could also find yourself and your travel partners scattered around the plane or in middle seats even if you reserved aisle or window seat. I doubt this small company could even have any actual client outside of people that are placed on their planes without any choice. Avoid this company at all costs and avoid Norwegian, since it can randomly put you on one of this planes with just a few day notice.
reviews.author: Leonardo

reviews.title: Messy
reviews.text: Left late after a very confusing and messy boarding. Had seats that were supposed to be together on different rows. No entertainment on board. Seats extremely unconfortable, narrow, and close. I will never fly Norwegian or Euro Atlantic again.
reviews.author: cfrrez73

reviews.title: Never Ever fligth again Old seats and planes
reviews.text: What horrible fligth, old planes no movies non reclineable seats for 8 hours trip imposible to sleep for business class is more like taking the bus, but old the buses , the new buses are better than this crappy old plane.
reviews.author: Fernando Fernandez

reviews.title: More than satisfactory
reviews.text: Just landed after a Euroatlantic flight from Newark to Rome. Norwegian airlines changed our aircraft and company and I must confess that all these reviews on tripadvisor had alarmed and upset me. Basically, I was prepared to live a 7 hour long nightmare. But, unexpectedly, it turned out to be one of the best flights of my life! I had a comfy seat (emergency exit) and didn’t have any food except for coffee and a sandwich, but concerning staff and services I cannot complain at all. Temperature was good - neither too hot nor too cold, seats reclined well, staff was extremely helpful and handled difficulties (eg change of the whole seating plan!) with the utmost care. For like the second time in my life I managed to sleep tight during the whole trip. Thumbs up for Euroatlantic! Not luxury of course, but definitely not miserable either!!
reviews.author: Flazzina

reviews.title: Worst plane I've ever been on
reviews.text: Was supposed to be flying Norwegian Airlines but they made a switch the night before my flight back home and put me on Euro Atlantic Airlines. The staff was very disorganized during boarding and some staff were out right rude to passengers. Upon stepping on the plane we were informed it was "open seating" which is a nightmare. The seats are so small and cramped. There is not on board entertainment. This is an 8 hour flight with nothing to do. There isn't even a ace to put your phone on the seat on front of you. I am so angry at Norwegian Airlines for ruining the end of my vacation and will never fly them again. If you see Euro Atlantic being switched from the flight you choose, run!
reviews.author: Alex A

reviews.title: Smelly, uncomfortable, no inflight entertainment!!
reviews.text: We were originally flying with Norwegian and received notification that it was originally being leased to a Spanish charter company, then after being informed that there was a 7 hour delay, we received another message saying out flight had been leased out to Euro Atlantic. Once we boarded the plane, the smell of damp hit you immediately. There was no Economy Plus, so those passengers who had paid extra for this were not happy, to say the least! The seats were the old leather-type cover with ripped off head covers. They were so small, you couldn't turn round comfortably. There was no in-flight entertainment whatsoever. I had actually looked this company up before leaving and was prepared with downloaded movies on my phone. However, other passengers, including the family member I travelled with, were unable to do this and had to either sleep or stare at the seat in front! The crew on the flight were friendly and the meal was passable; we were able to get more than one glass of wine with dinner, unlike the charter we flew back with (that's another story!). Overall, I am very disappointed with Norwegian and would never book with them again, due to fears that this would happen again, as it seems to be an ongoing problem. We are claiming compensation for the 7-hour delay; hope that comes through OK!!!
reviews.author: Karen W

reviews.title: No information No space Not friendly personnel
reviews.text: This company was flying on behalf og Norwegian as they have problems with their Max planes. We booked the 21:25 flight. They put up a 15 minute delay on the info screen but no boarding started unntil 22:15 After complete boarding we sat another 30 minutes with no AC and no further information swetting in a more and more hotter airplane The plane was a Boieing 767 The seats are not comfortable and it is very limited space sideways and to the seat in front of you The personnel did not give any information away from the practical standards. Even if cabin crew Are not allowed to or expected to give that kind og information a smile would be of big Impact. If they had to receive new slot times that is very easy understandable so please let us know what is going on from cockpiten. I am happy we were nor travelling with kids in this awkward situation.
reviews.author: MorErik2015

reviews.title: Trash
reviews.text: Very tight legspace No holder for mobile etc on the seat in front of you. Why? Dont know. Just poor. Awful plane.
reviews.author: Omar

reviews.title: Cabin in desperate need of an update but great flight
reviews.text: We flew on one of their 767's (CS-TSV) on June 30, as a charted flight for Icelandair. While the cabin crew was from icelandair, one flight attendant and the pilots were from Euroatlantic. Yes, the cabin was old and the leather on some seats was coming off, however we felt that the seats were still comfortable. IFE did not work, but we could connect to an entertainment system on our phones. The selection was poor and the connection was slow, however we had downloaded movies before the flight so we were OK. While we did not interact with the euroatlantic flight attendant, we did notice that she was very helpful and attentive when passengers were struggling with the entertainment system. And for the most important part, the flying - we thought it was immaculate! Very smooth flight and a beautiful landing! The pilots were very informative and well spoken in their announcements. Great job!
reviews.author: Sam D

reviews.title: Worst seat pitch ever
reviews.text: One of their 767-300 ER planes was used by Azores Airlines. I'm 6'0". My knees were crammed against the seat in front. When I put the tray table down the front of the tray was pushed into my stomach and I was sitting all the way back in my seat. Worst I have ever experienced.
reviews.author: Windrider354

reviews.title: Never again.
reviews.text: Originally booked Icelandic air direct flight from Halifax to Reykjavik Iceland. Due to the grounding of the Boeing Max airplanes they cancelled all thier summer flights out of Halifax and rebooked us flying out of Toronto. The day of our flight we were told the Icelandic air flight would facilitated by Euro Atlantic. This airline should not be used for long haul overnight flights. This plane has the most narrow and uncomfortable seats I have ever sat in. My hips are black and blue from the arm rests digging into them for the nearly 6 hours of the overnight flight. My husband could not even sit with his knees infront of him. The seat configuration in economy was 8 seats across 2-4-2 (typically for a boeing767 it is 7across!). I sat on j offered blankets for comfort, due to the ultra thin seat padding. And no individual air made the flight unbarable. Do not recommend for long haul flights. Never again.
reviews.author: shutterbug_506

reviews.title: Unexpected excellence despite bad prior reviews generally
reviews.text: I booked on Icelandair to go to Iceland from Boston and at the last minute I was notified that euro Atlantic airways was going to be stepping up to the plate because the 737 max airplanes that Icelandair had invested in grounded. Anyway it was with much trepidation that I boarded the flight and I was pleasantly surprised. First of all the cabin staff was Icelandic. The pilot I believe was from Portugal but he did an excellent job. Seats were lie-flat. TV screen was very large. Food and beverage service was excellent ...all in all, service on euro Atlantic airways surpassed business class service/first class service that I have endured from the likes of Delta Airlines and United on domestic routes. The 767 plane that Euro Atlantic used was very well refurbished. I have nothing negative to say and only positive things. The takeaway is that you should not be afraid to travel on this airline. They are being held to a very high standard with Iceland 767 plane that Euro Atlantic used was very well refurbished. I have nothing negative to say and only positive things. Thx that you should not be afraid to travel on this airline. They are being held to a very high standard with Icelandair. Give them a try. But only go business class
reviews.author: NDAS Honestly

reviews.title: Poor service and discomfort seats
reviews.text: Very bad seatings no legroom and practically the knees are against the front seat . Having said that an all economy configuration aircraft B767-300 with an 80% load the blocked all the toilets but 2 . Arrogant cabin crew , very bad service ask for a repeat coffee the response is No 2nd service . Airfare is extremely expensive . Not worthy and bad value for your money . Avoid it if you can
reviews.author: fedtnt

reviews.title: Narrowest seats ever
reviews.text: Have flown often, but never experienced a seat as narrow as this one. Entertainment screen froze a few minutes into the flight. Asked flight attendant to fix it. She poked the screen a couple of times w/no result, then simply walked away. Flight attendants paid little attention to safety, such as upright seatbacks for landing/takeoff, or large bags not tucked under the seat. Food was O.K.
reviews.author: SquareG

reviews.title: smooth flight with a littlebit old aircraft from JFK to BUD
reviews.text: We bougt our tickets fpr the LOT Polish Airlines new Boeing 787 Dreamliner direct flight from and to Budapest-JKF. Unfortunately the LOT replaced the planes to Euroatlantic 767-300ERs. It was a bit unfair since everybody knows the difference between the two planes. However our flight was very smooth and on time in booth direction, almost to be said comfortable how it can be on the economy. The service was the LOT standard, polish and hungarian cabin crew was attended also the flights beside the original Portugese cabin crew. I felt that they tried to do their best under the given conditions. The meal, the refreshments, the entertainment system all were OK, but new content would be loaded on it.... Summarizing I felt myself in safe however the plane was not the newest one, and the crew was also polite and looked experienced.
reviews.author: Csaba S

reviews.title: From Newark To Paris Orly
reviews.text: For the ~200 I paid for the flight, it was perfectly satisfactory. There was a 1-hour delay bc of weather, they did get us off the ground ASAP. The flight was fine; it was an overnight so I took a Dramamine and passed out. My mother came with me last minute so I gave her my precious exit row seat. My advice is to pay extra for the exit row seats. WORTH IT! I was able to get a row to myself. The crew was fine, not first class Air France but attentive and sticklers for safety.
reviews.author: jacquelyn c
